Class NoticeVersion

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.entity.NoticeVersion
@Entity(name="notice_versions") public class NoticeVersion extends Object
One saved version of the "Notices, Terms and Conditions" text shown on the TA (or ULA) application form.

Versions are never edited or deleted: every save by an admin is a new row with its own id and timestamp, and an application records the id of the version its applicant agreed to, so what they agreed to can always be shown back exactly. The text is Markdown, edited with the same EasyMDE editor proj-citelines uses and rendered with react-markdown.
